limitations: This analyzer does not fit models; the separate C_REBASE_V1 recipe was frozen before training.
Patient/device/anatomical associations are confounded; 24 people provide limited precision.
Source image Lab D65/2 versus instrument D65/10 differences are coordinate proxies, never physical DeltaE00.
Within-site variability needs other photos; these diagnostic variables are unavailable to single-photo deployment.
Reference exclusions use measured targets and are leaky diagnostics.
No subtraction of instrument DeltaE00; no causal fraction or identifiable attainable floor asserted.
The supplied OOF training provenance must be checked separately from these alignment checks.
Swapping a falsely declared index between photos with identical site targets cannot be detected from targets alone; the original OOF index contract and archive provenance are required.
No validated causal allocation among instrument, capture and estimator errors is identifiable from this observational dataset.
Same-site observations cross acquisition modes; no repeated independent reference sessions or same-mode photograph replicates were established.
Capture quartiles and reference exclusions are privileged diagnostics, not deployable photo-quality gates.
Clinical close-up/dermoscopy TRAIN OOF is not an independent selfie/instrument-reference test.

squared_coordinate_error_decomposition.identity: image-weighted MSE(pred-target) = MSE(pred-site_mean_pred) + MSE(site_mean_pred-target); target fixed within site
squared_coordinate_error_decomposition.units: squared Lab coordinate units; not perceptual DeltaE00 variance

oracle_evaluations.name: same_site_mean_prediction_multiframe
oracle_evaluations.definition: Mean frozen OOF predictions over all images of a site including this image; privileged grouping and multiple captures, not single-photo deployment.

oracle_evaluations.name: same_site_other_images_mean_prediction
oracle_evaluations.definition: Mean frozen OOF predictions of other same-site images; excludes this image, needs other captures and exact site identity.

oracle_evaluations.name: patient_other_unique_sites_residual_bias_correction
oracle_evaluations.definition: Subtract mean Lab residual of the patient's other unique sites, each site equally weighted; uses that held-out patient's other instrument targets and is leaky.

squared_coordinate_error_decomposition.interpretation: An algebraic decomposition of this frozen estimator. Within-site prediction variation combines capture changes and model sensitivity; site mean bias combines estimator bias and shared capture/reference ambiguity. Neither term uniquely identifies a causal data/model share.

instrument_repeatability.assessment_interpretation: Dictionary documents 1st/2nd/3rd colorimeter assessments; unique recordings, but timing/repositioning/random independence is not encoded in tables.

single_assessment_vs_triplet_mean.warning: Same reading contributes to its reference, descriptive only

held_assessment_vs_other_two_mean.warning: Assesses single-reading vs two-reading mean disagreement, not a deployable color-model error floor

triplet_target_sensitivity_to_omitting_o.warning: Reference perturbation, not known latent truth

site_repeatability.independent_across_acquisition_site_reme: NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: one reference triplet per tag_id; no independent session repeated targets
site_repeatability.zero_pair_target_difference_interpretati: Label reuse; not evidence that repeatability noise or biological change equals zero.

reference_oracles.name: same_site_leave_image_out
reference_oracles.definition: Other image targets at exact patient+tag_id; shares the same S4 reference triplet, so zero is tautological.

reference_oracles.name: same_site_nearest_observed
reference_oracles.definition: Other exact-site image nearest in authors' published median image Lab Euclidean coordinates; reference triplet is shared.

reference_oracles.name: patient_other_sites
reference_oracles.definition: Equal-site mean of other unique measurement sites of same person, excluding all images sharing target site's reference.

reference_oracles.name: patient_same_camera_other_sites
reference_oracles.definition: Same-person/same-device other unique sites; camera is person-confounded, so equals patient oracle.

reference_oracles.name: same_camera_anatomic_region_other_sites
reference_oracles.definition: Mean of other unique TRAIN sites with same device and recorded anatomical region; target's exact tag_id excluded; references from other people are used.

reference_oracles.name: same_site_leave_reference_observation_out
reference_oracles.reason: Each exact site has one S4 triplet only; excluding its shared reference removes all same-site neighbours.

iid_reference_mean_noise_proxy.assumptions: Three independent, zero-mean, identically distributed readings of the same latent color; not established by released metadata.
iid_reference_mean_noise_proxy.interpretation: Conditional scale comparison only, not a causal noise share, latent error floor, or valid quantity to subtract from DeltaE00.

provenance.alignment: Exact original row permutation, target equality, pseudonym/site metadata checks, one fold per patient and four patients per fold
